responsibility: Declares the macro-name spellchecking support used by C-family diagnostics. It provides edit-distance trait specializations for cpp_hashnode macro identifiers and the best_macro_match helper class that searches cpplib’s identifier table for the closest macro spelling to a queried tree name.
same_name_distinction: Interface/header side of macro spellchecking: it declares name_reserved_for_implementation_p, specializes edit_distance_traits for cpp_hashnode, and defines best_macro_match, while c-spellcheck.cc implements the filtering and identifier-table search logic.
